prompt:
Scene:
A square photograph at pre-dawn blue hour, drone-height aerial view looking down at a 45-degree angle, 24mm cinema lens, deep blue ambient with first warm light on the horizon.

Subject:
A perfectly flat plateau one kilometer across, made of a single diamond crystal, hovering 300 meters above a dark forested valley. The top surface has natural crystalline facets forming a shallow mosaic. Because it is real diamond, every facet captures the pre-dawn sky above and the dark forest below and performs total internal reflection, resulting in a dazzling scatter of pinpoint highlights and bounced sky fragments across its surface.

Important details:
Diamond fire — strong spectral dispersion from the first warm horizon sun punches rainbow pinpoints across the upper surface. The underside of the plateau is completely clear, showing the forest directly beneath through the crystal. A fine mist of fog swirls around the edge, making the plateau read as both solid and ghostly. Four tiny helicopters in formation for scale at the far edge.

Use case:
Crystal-studies single 5/5 — the final and most extreme study: a floating plateau of pure diamond.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no Ayn-Rand-style monolith towers, no buildings on top, no sci-fi force field lines, no painterly stylization.
title: Diamond Plateau
description: A floating diamond plateau one kilometer wide, scattering pre-dawn dispersion fire.
